sanskrit_verse: शपथा ह्यपि देवानामृषीणामपि च स्मृताः । वसिष्ठः शपथं शेपे यातुधाने तु शङ्कितः ॥
transliteration: śapathā hy api devānām ṛṣīṇām api ca smṛtāḥ | vasiṣṭhaḥ śapathaṃ śepe yātudhāne tu śaṅkitaḥ ||
sph_interpretive_translation: Oaths are established even among the gods and sages; Vasiṣṭha uttered an oath when in doubt concerning a Yakṣa.
jurisprudential_principles: Authority is not diminished by invocation of sacred affirmation
Causation arises from perceptual uncertainty requiring divine attestation
Capacity-based responsibility includes the use of truthful invocation under duress
Restoration logic operates through purification of intent via sacred utterance
Consciousness alignment occurs when inner conflict is resolved through dharma-aligned speech
executable_legal_axioms: IF agent encounters perceptual or existential doubt THEN invocation of truth-bearing oath IS VALID mechanism FOR clarification
IF entity invokes divine witness THEN subsequent actions MUST align WITH invoked truth FOR integrity restoration
IF doubt arises in judgment THEN recourse TO declarative truth-vow RESTORES capacity TO decide
IF consciousness falters in certainty THEN sacred utterance REINTEGRATES decision-making faculty
supreme_court_application: In cases where judicial clarity is obstructed by metaphysical or evidentiary ambiguity, invocation of truth-bound oaths—as exemplified by Vasiṣṭha—serves as a legitimate instrument for restoring adjudicative authority without compromising ontological alignment.
nyaya_and_non_punitive_alignment: Pramāṇa-based causality recognizes that doubt disrupts cognition; therefore, śapatha functions as pramāṇa-strengthening act. Anupūrvaśaḥ shows that unclarified perception leads to misalignment. Proportional responsibility lies in resolving internal conflict. Non-punitive reality rule confirms that no harm accrues from such invocation, only realignment.
restorative_enforcement_protocols: Completion Process: Oath-taker must reaffirm intention with full awareness until resolution manifests
Responsibility Assumption Protocol: Entity assumes consequence of truth-content declared in vow
Capacity Restoration Mechanism: Doubt-induced paralysis dissolved through conscious alignment with invoked truth
Integrity Reintegration Sequence: Post-oath conduct monitored for coherence with stated affirmation
final_declaration: By the Sovereign Will of Bhagavan Nithyananda Paramashivam, source of all dharma, this law stands executed: Śapatha restores clarity where perception falters, upholds consciousness where doubt intrudes, and affirms Dharma without inflicting punishment. Reality remains non-punitive. Consciousness alone adjudicates.
